prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: A Cooler Courtyard; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: An illustrative school courtyard over several days at morning and lunchtime. Locked Kit and Zoe retain designs. One unnamed caretaker: deep-brown skin, bald head, round glasses, gray shirt and navy pants, about 1.7 times child height. Fixed layout: a wall runs along the east side with an open doorway near its north end; a broad route leads from that doorway across the courtyard; bench area west, young tree southwest. Morning sun from the east casts the wall's shadow westward into the courtyard. By midday the proposed morning sitting spot is sunny. No claim to a real measured site.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One plain wooden bench on west side, short new tree with small leafy crown southwest; Open doorway near north end of eastern wall and broad clear route across courtyard; Small clipboard with an unlabelled courtyard sketch; Later one properly installed pale-green shade canopy supported by four posts outside walking route
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: No child touches overheated surfaces; existing courtyard only, no canopy.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Midday sunlit bench with small tree shadow falling away from it; children and caretaker examine the space.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.

visualReview.note: Generated source and installed WebP inspected. Bald caretaker with glasses and locked equal-height children; west bench, southwest young tree and doorway on east wall. Plan agrees with natural location. Canopy design has four supports and must appear only after installation.
